content:
maria: Quick sweep before tomorrow's SDK/docs/quickstarts ship — a few tiny asks.

maria: TL;DR: please confirm 1) sdk binaries published 2) quickstarts CI green 3) docs site build + changelog entries merged. Trying to avoid last-minute surprises.

jonathan: I'll run the publish right now and post artifacts link. ping @sam_k for any remaining sampleapp fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412

sam_k: quickstarts PR merged (fixes sample template), sample-apps CI was flaky earlier but is green on retry: https://ci.example.com/build/987 — added a retry in GH actions.

devex-bot: [ci] quickstarts/sample-apps — job 987 finished: SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (logs: https://ci.example.com/build/987/logs)

lee-docs: docs site build failed on staging due to a relative link in quickstart-setup.md, opened & merged fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/225 — staging build passed after merge.

kevin-ops: I'll kick the staging smoke deploy and run through the quickstart template flow at 08:30 PT. If anything breaks I'll post details and a rollback plan.

jonathan: publish completed — binaries uploaded to artifacts/redwood-sdk/0.14.0 (s3://artifacts/redwood-sdk/0.14.0). Tag and release draft created.

maria: Changelog guidance: please add a single one-line under "Changed" in CHANGELOG.md. Example format to copy: 

``n- SDK: bump to 0.14.0; add sample app templates for repo-scoped auth. (#412)
``

sam_k: added changelog entry in #410 and fixed formatting (markdown lint). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/410 — ready to merge.

maria: Great. Last ask: owners please respond with a quick :thumbsup: when your area is ship-ready. If you need a minute extension call it out now.

jonathan: :thumbsup: — binaries + release draft done.

sam_k: :thumbsup: — sampleapps CI green, changelog updated.

lee-docs: :thumbsup: — docs fixed and staging build passing.

kevin-ops: running smoke now (08:31 PT). If green I'll post :thumbsup:.

devex-bot: Reminder scheduled: release reminders will post 30m before ship window.

maria: Thanks all — I'll run final publish checklist at 09:00 PT and flip the release flag. If anyone sees anything after this thread, drop it here and i'll coordinate the hotfix flow.
